                nxt = best_node
            route.append(nxt)
            customers.remove(nxt)
            load += demands[nxt]
            current = nxt
        routes.append(route)

    # --- deterministic local improvements (small, interpretable edits) ---
    # 1) Intra-route 2-opt (best-improvement within each route, deterministic scan)
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        for idx in range(len(routes)):
            r = routes[idx]
            m = len(r)
            if m < 4:
                continue
            best_delta = 0
            best_i = -1
            best_j = -1
            # scan 2-opt: break edges (i-1,i) and (j,j+1), reverse segment [i..j]
            for i in range(1, m - 2):
                a = r[i - 1]
                b = r[i]
                dab = matrix[a][b]
                for j in range(i + 1, m - 1):
                    c = r[j]
                    d = r[j + 1]
                    # current edges: a-b, c-d; new edges: a-c, b-d
                    cur = dab + matrix[c][d]
                    new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    delta = new - cur
                    if delta < best_delta:
                        best_delta = delta
                        best_i, best_j = i, j
            if best_delta < 0:
                i, j = best_i, best_j
                routes[idx] = r[:i] + r[i:j + 1][::-1] + r[j + 1:]
                improved = True

    # helper for best delta for inserting x into route j at end/begin only
    def can_add(route_j, x, load_j):
        return load_j + demands[x] <= capacity

    # 2) Inter-route relocation: move a single customer from end of route i to start/end of route j if feasible and improves cost.
    # This is targeted and usually helps clustered/corridor structures.
    def route_cost_with_changes(i_route, j_route, i_remove_pos, j_insert_pos, insert_dir):
        # insert_dir: 0 => at beginning, 1 => at end
        # compute cost delta by edges, assuming remove_pos is last (pos = len-1) for simplicity.
        ri = i_route
        rj = j_route
        x = ri[i_remove_pos]

        # remove x from end of ri
        a = ri[-2] if len(ri) >= 2 else depot
        # ri currently ends with ... a-x and x->depot
        cur_remove = matrix[a][x] + matrix[x][depot]
        new_remove = matrix[a][depot]  # after removal, a directly to depot (if i becomes empty, handled by a=depot)
        # compute cost of insertion into rj
        if not rj:
            # inserting into empty (shouldn't happen), treat as depot->x->depot
            cur_ins = 0
            new_ins = matrix[depot][x] + matrix[x][depot]
        else:
            if insert_dir == 0:
                # insert at beginning: depot->first becomes depot->x->first
                y = rj[0]
                cur_ins = matrix[depot][y] if len(rj) == 1 else matrix[depot][y]
                new_ins = matrix[depot][x] + matrix[x][y]
            else:
                # insert at end: last->depot becomes last->x->depot
                y = rj[-1]
                cur_ins = matrix[y][depot] if len(rj) == 1 else matrix[y][depot]
                new_ins = matrix[y][x] + matrix[x][depot]
        return (new_remove + new_ins) - (cur_remove + cur_ins)

    # compute loads once
    loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]

    # perform a few deterministic passes
    passes = 2
    while passes > 0:
        passes -= 1
        best_global_delta = 0
        best_move = None  # (i, j, insert_dir)
        # scan candidates: prefer moves from longer routes and into tight routes (lower load)
        order_i = sorted(range(len(routes)), key=lambda i: (-len(routes[i]), loads[i], i))
        for i in order_i:
            ri = routes[i]
            if not ri:
                continue
            x = ri[-1]
            li = loads[i]
            a = ri[-2] if len(ri) >= 2 else depot
            # remove benefit/cost depends on successor; we just use edge delta during evaluation
            order_j = sorted(range(len(routes)), key=lambda j: (loads[j], j))
            for j in order_j:
                if j == i:
                    continue
                if not routes[j]:
                    continue
                rj = routes[j]
                lj = loads[j]
                if not can_add(rj, x, lj):
                    continue
                # insertion at beginning
                delta0 = route_cost_with_changes(ri, rj, len(ri) - 1, 0, 0)
                # insertion at end
                delta1 = route_cost_with_changes(ri, rj, len(ri) - 1, len(rj), 1)
                if delta0 < best_global_delta:
                    best_global_delta = delta0
                    best_move = (i, j, 0)
                if delta1 < best_global_delta:
                    best_global_delta = delta1
                    best_move = (i, j, 1)
        if best_move is not None:
            i, j, ins_dir = best_move
            x = routes[i][-1]
            # apply
            routes[i] = routes[i][:-1]
            loads[i] -= demands[x]
            if ins_dir == 0:
                routes[j] = [x] + routes[j]
            else:
                routes[j] = routes[j] + [x]
            loads[j] += demands[x]
            # cleanup: if a route becomes empty, remove it (keeping structure consistent)
            if not routes[i]:
                routes.pop(i)
                loads.pop(i)
        else:
            break

    # 3) Optional deterministic merging of identical-feasible adjacent structures using end-to-start concatenation
    # (keep small: one sweep only)
    # If i ends with u and j starts with v, try to concatenate entire routes if capacity allows and cost improves.
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        n = len(routes)
        # scan deterministically by potential savings (cheapest cross)
        best_delta = 0
        best_pair = None  # (i, j)
        for i in range(n):
            if not routes[i]:
                continue
            ui = routes[i][-1]
            li = loads[i]
            for j in range(n):
                if i == j or not routes[j]:
                    continue
                vj = routes[j][0]
                if li + loads[j] > capacity:
                    continue
                # cost before: ...->ui->depot + depot->vj->...
                cur = matrix[ui][depot] + matrix[depot][vj]
                # cost after concatenation i followed by j:
                # ...->ui->vj->...
                new = matrix[ui][vj]
                delta = new - cur
                if delta < best_delta:
                    best_delta = delta
                    best_pair = (i, j)
        if best_pair is not None:
            i, j = best_pair
            # apply merge: routes[i] + routes[j]
            routes[i] = routes[i] + routes[j]
            loads[i] += loads[j]
            # remove j
            routes.pop(j)
            loads.pop(j)
            changed = True

    return routes
